findings.finding: Q3 2026 operating profit is set to multiply YoY. The comparison base is Q3 2025's RMB28.3m (1.7% margin, down 73.7% YoY), and management guided 'meaningful breakthroughs at the operating profit level in 2H 2026' after a record Q2 of RMB111.5m. Gross margin was 48.9% in Q2 against 42.2% in Q3 2025, so Q3 2026 operating profit of RMB100-150m (3.5-5x YoY) is the base case. The market's expectation is a profit turnaround (Citi target raised on margin-first strategy; 'Strong Buy').
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Operating profit is the line this stock has traded on: Q2 2026 record operating profit plus a large EPS beat gave +1.26% (with a revenue miss), and Q1 2026 operating profit -44.7% gave -6.94%. Q3 2025 operating profit -73.7% gave -8.1% (pre-market -7.69%, https://www-web.itiger.com/news/1170468497).
findings.why_not_priced: The direction is largely priced: the stock re-rated +34% from late September to mid-October and management told the market to expect 2H profit gains, so this lands inside the qualitative guide. What is not in the price is the size. No consensus figure for Q3 operating profit could be sourced, and the only EPS bar is a single, currency-ambiguous number. If the market had a firm profit bar, an estimate would be published by two sources and spot would sit above the mean target, not at it.
findings.independence: Management guide from the Q2 call (https://earningswhispers.com/transcript/DAO/Q22026, 2026-08-20) is a different document from the Q3 2025 base-period release; Q2 2026 gross margin 48.9% from https://finviz.com/news/383943/youdao-reports-second-quarter-2026-unaudited-financial-results

findings.finding: Headline Q3 revenue is likely flat to down YoY and below the RMB1.669bn consensus (+2.5% YoY). Online marketing laps a +51.1% quarter (RMB739.7m in Q3 2025) while management prioritises profit over growth (Q2 online marketing -7.7%). Smart devices were -31.5% in Q2 off a Q3 2025 base of about RMB246m. The rest of the company: learning services, which grew +20.9% in Q2, laps an easy -16.2% base (RMB643.1m), so a +20% learning quarter (about +RMB130m) offsets a -10 to -15% ads quarter (-RMB75-110m) and a -25 to -30% device quarter (-RMB60-75m). That builds to about RMB1.53-1.65bn, central about 1.59bn (-4.5% against the bar). Chartmill shows the revenue estimate already cut 9.39% in 3 months.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 revenue missed ($215.9m against $229.0m, about -5.7%) and the stock still rose +1.26% on the profit beat. This name has not punished revenue misses that come with profit beats.
findings.why_not_priced: The consensus has been cut 9.4% but still implies growth. A segment build from the company's own releases points to a decline, the first YoY revenue decline in the recent run. If that were priced, the revenue estimate would sit near or below Q3 2025's RMB1.6285bn. The bar comes from one source, so the size is capped.
findings.independence: Q3 2025 segment base from a separate document (https://www.barchart.com/story/news/36222973/youdao-reports-third-quarter-2025-unaudited-financial-results); consensus and revision from Chartmill (https://www.chartmill.com/stock/quote/DAO/estimates)

It bears on the reaction because a profit beat into a stock already re-rated against a falling sector needs more than consensus to rise. If the run-up had already been given back, the 20-day return would be negative and spot would sit well below the mean target.

findings.why_not_priced: These are product and user metrics with no money attached. The late-September to mid-October run-up likely already carries the AI narrative, so this is sized small.

findings.finding: The buyback has US$40m authorised and about US$33.8m used by 2026-06-30 (about US$6.2m left), with the program extended to 2027-11-17. Cash and short-term investments were RMB849.3m against a RMB878.0m short-term NetEase loan plus US$118.9m long-term; the filing ties going concern to operating cash flow and external (NetEase) financing. Q2 operating cash flow was +80.7% to RMB334.2m, and that cash funds a profitable, cash-generative business rather than a deficit.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No observed reaction to buyback news on prints.
findings.why_not_priced: A new or upsized authorisation would be news. The remaining capacity is small. Financing question answered: the NetEase loans fund working capital in a business now generating operating cash, so this is neutral to slightly positive, not distress.

baseline_tension: No skew to agree or disagree with (unusable chain). The slight negative lean rests on the run-up against a weak sector and on revenue, and it cuts against the profit trajectory that the stock last rewarded (+1.26%). p_up is therefore held near 50.
lessons_applied: Lesson 1 (verified fact is not a reaction; the last profit beat bought only +1.26%) plus lesson 6 (lands inside management's qualitative 2H guide): profit finding cut from +1.5 to +0.8.
Lesson 6 (bar has one source with an ambiguous EPS currency): revenue finding capped from -1.2 to -0.8, and the next-guide finding from -0.5 to -0.3.
Lesson 5 (proxy, not company-confirmed): the NetEase-launch counterparty went from -0.4 to -0.3, the TAL devices peer from -0.3 to -0.2 and the Baidu ads peer from -0.3 to -0.2.
Rebuilt the base rate from six confirmed prints (median |move| about 7.5%) per the untrustworthy-history lesson, and dropped the 2026-04-15 20-F row; abs_move_pct stays 7.5, unchanged.
Lesson 3 (caveats toward 50): p_up moved from 47 to 48; scaled move from -0.42 to -0.30.
Lesson 7: short interest checked before the negatives; it is not crowded by count, so the negatives were not shrunk for a squeeze, but the high days-to-cover kept as a small positive finding.
